title: Klaus Fuchs atomic espionage

tellings.quote: that like the next Klaus Fuchs you know the guy that like stole the American atomic secrets worked at Los Alamos from 1941 to 1950

plain: Klaus Fuchs was a scientist who stole American atomic bomb secrets while working at Los Alamos, the New Mexico lab where the bomb was built, from 1941 to 1950. Michels mentions it in passing, without naming a source, in an episode with a guest named Dave Rossi. He uses Fuchs as a comparison, wondering aloud who might be "the next Klaus Fuchs" for today's secrets.
